statement: For every dyadic node xy=pi^n u the generic G0(R[C2]) kernel is cyclic of exponent dividing n with trivial sign twist; the Swan generic kernel maps to zero in G0 and in the ordinary MCM Grothendieck group when n is odd
notes: Route boundary only. Existing unramified odd-node nonzero classes prove noninjectivity within reduced normal domains. Does not settle ramified-node polynomiality.
